content: प्रयत्नः .²1 Effort, exertion, endeavour; तस्येदं विपुलं विधेर्विलसितं पुसां प्रयत्नच्छिदः <ls>Mu. 5. 20</ls>. .²2 Persevering or continued effort; perseverance. .²3 Labour, difficulty; प्रयत्नप्रेक्षणीयः संवृत्तः <ls>Ś. 1</ls> ‘hardly visible’, ‘seen with difficulty’. .²4 Great care, caution; कृतप्रयत्नोऽपि गृहे विनश्यति <ls>Pt. 1. 20</ls>. .²5 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Effort in uttering, effort of the mouth in the production of articulate sounds; see <ls>Sk.</ls> on <ls>P. VIII. 2. 1</ls>. .²6 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Active effort of three kinds; प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिश्च तथा जीवनकारणम् . एवं प्रयत्नत्र्यैविध्यं तान्त्रिकैः परिदर्शितम् .. .²7 Activity, action in general.
